sentences.text: S.P. Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12

Author: Sanjay Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Dwivedi
 1 Wp-25419
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Wp-25419-2019
 (S.P. Shrivastava Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others)
 2
 Jabalpur, Dated : 12-02-2020
 Shri R.K. Verma, learned Senior Advocate with Shri Ashish Datta,
 Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Vikalp Soni, learned Government Advocate f  respondents/State.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that vide order dated 22.11.2019 (Annexure-P/18),
the petitioner has been denotified without assigning any reason.

Although, his appointment was made in accordance with the provisions of the Act i.e. Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 especially under Section 37 of the said Act, however, the order impugned does not contain any reason as to why the appointment of the petitioner was denotified on the post of Food Safety Officer.
On earlier occasion, notices were issued and the respondents have been directed to submit their reply, but till date, no reply has been filed.
By way of last opportunity, Shri Soni, is granted fifteen days' time to file reply, otherwise respondent No.3 shall remain present before this Court on the next date of hearing.

It is made clear that if the reply is not filed, the interim relief claimed by the petitioner shall be considered without further waiting for reply.
(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
